description: This file declares functions related to handling object IDs, including parsing arbitrary hex strings into object IDs and determining the hash algorithm used, based on environment variables.

methods.name: cl_parse_any_oid
methods.description: Converts a hex string into an object_id, generating a 40-character hex string of a hash, with constraints based on hash type and environment.

methods.name: cl_setup_hash_algo
methods.description: Determines the hash algorithm used (SHA1, SHA256, or UNKNOWN) based on environment variable GIT_TEST_DEFAULT_HASH.
